record.dic_text:
03324 Yitshar {yits-hawr'}

與 03323 同 ; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Izhar 8, Izehar 1; 9

以斯哈 = "光亮的油"
1) 哥轄的兒子, 利未的孫子, 摩西和亞倫的叔叔, 
   可拉的父親; 以斯哈族的祖先
record.edic_text:
03324 Yitshar {yits-hawr'}

the same as 03323;; n pr m

AV - Izhar 8, Izehar 1; 9

Izhar = "shining oil"
1) son of Kohath, grandson of Levi, uncle of Moses and Aaron, and
   father of Korah; progenitor of the Izharites
